title: Trellis House Apartments
name: Celine J.
text:
I had a really frustrating experience with Trellis House DC. I went in person three separate times to ask about available units and spoke with two different leasing workers. One of the women was somewhat helpful, but instead of giving me an actual guided tour, she just told me to walk around and tour the property myself.

Calling the office is also frustrating because you get connected to an AI assistant instead of a real person. The AI gave me completely different answers than the leasing agents did, which made the whole process confusing and inconsistent.

Demetrius was especially unhelpful and came across as rude and dismissive. His tone was monotone, and it felt like he did not care about answering questions or helping potential residents. On top of that, the website is confusing and difficult to navigate.

Overall, the customer service and communication made the apartment search process much more stressful than it needed to be. There are honestly much better apartment options in the area with staff who are more professional, responsive, and welcoming. Based on my experience, I would not recommend living here.

title: Trellis House Apartments
name: Q Da Gawd
text: I warn you: If you are a working ADULT and value peace and quiet, DO NOT (I repeat) DO NOT move here. I lived him from 2021-2026 and saw the management shift from CIM to Berkshire. During that time, Trellis House was unofficially converted into a de facto Howard University DORM where (by my estimates) 75-80% of its residents are under 21 years old. There's endless marijuana (and cigarette) smoking in this supposed 'smoke-free' building, loud music playing into the wee hours of the morning (3-4 AM), and the consequence(s) of having mostly teenagers as your main clientele. And they have the unmitigated gall to call this a 'luxury' complex. That's not true--at least not anymore. Finally, CrossFit MPH (a gym they rent retail space on the ground floor) drops HEAVY weights from morning until evening. It's so loud and obtrusive that the weights can be both FELT and HEARD on the top floor of the building. You have been warned. If you don't mind living with teenagers who never sleep, listening to loud BOOMS and BANGS from s gym all day, and can tolerate marijuana and cigarette smoke, then this is the place for you! If you have any sense (or are over 30 years old), I would highly suggest you find a building/complex that actually caters to adults and not college kids. You have been warned.

text:
lived here for 4 years. Could tell right away it was cheaply made. Super loud too. Lots of college kids. Bad management. Obviously just a bad installation. Both sinks and the shower leaked the entire time I was there. I sent them records of multiple service requests I had made to fix this, but they never bothered to respond.

Edit: They said 3 times they would send me pictures, but never did. I emailed them 2 times with the maintenance request receipts. I have also emailed them 3 times since they last responded. title: Trellis House Apartments
name: A-Team Travels
text:
Recently we went through an extremely challenging time trying to secure our college student housing, after she was denied housing for her senior year with a two week notice before the fall semester was to begin. Don't even get me started!!!

We contacted Trellis House and from start to finish the experience was AMAZING! Halston and Nicole did everything possible to make this experience the best it could be. From listening to our concerns to walking us step by step through the application process when we had issues. They were both stellar. Halston gave us a walk through on move in day and I must say she was thorough. I've never had that much fun on a moving day. We ALL know how difficult moving 🚚 can be.

The property is absolutely beautiful with plenty of amenities. Some of the amenities include: a pool area, event space, solarium, top deck, fitness/wellness area, dedicated study spaces and more. They have it all.

The apartments themselves are gorgeous and feature modern designs, ample closet space, all appliances (including washer/dryer), subway tile and beautiful hard wood floors. The building is secure and I'm confident in our daughter's safety while living here. They also have 24/7 concierge and Ms. Michelle is everything, wonderful and has been very welcoming.

I can't say enough about Trellis House and it's very competent and professional staff. Keep up the excellent work you all are doing. Halston and Nicole please know we're forever grateful for all you've done to assist our family through this transition. Thank you all so much for making this experience a less challenging and painful one!

text: Trellis house really is a beautiful building and in a great area in terms of transportation convenience. The structure of this building seems to have been poorly made. The walls are so thin, you can hear word for word conversations from neighbors. There are “quiet hours” in place but some tenants either don’t respect this policy or don’t realize how loud they are. There’s also daily smell of smoke in the hallway even though this is a non smoking building but this is not as big of a concern for me. The leasing team has been responsive and helpful in terms of dealing with my complaints (particularly Claudia has been extremely nice and accommodating) but the issues persist. If you are sensitive to sound, I would not recommend this building. Otherwise moving in was super easy with full access to the dock, the amenities are great, building is clean, location is great, apartment appliances are good, maintenance turnaround is quick, and receiving delivery/packages is super convenient with 24 hour concierge.

text: Great place to live. Concierge is amazing and very tentative to your needs. Leasing is available to answer any question and very prompt with responses.

title: Trellis House Apartments
name: Alicia Canseco
text: ¡Me encanta vivir aquí!

title: Trellis House Apartments
name: Christopher Soto
text: This apartment building has been an experience. An experience that got me through the process of grieving after my dad passed away, a new location to gather my friends while they support me through a rather bad breakup, a place in which I go back home after work and they welcome me with a smile every time. People as Antonette that makes my day with a smile or an inspirational quote every morning or Kiara for showing understanding through my struggles or Ashley for welcoming back home every single evening after a heavy day at work and even having the best maintenance team that have ever existed when it’s time to do my 3-month laundry but my washer is acting up 😝... they are truly the best. For this and so many other good reasons I recommend Trellis House 💯.

title: Trellis House Apartments
name: Vanessa Dorismond
text: Five stars ALL THE WAY!!! I just got my one year anniversary at this wonderful establishment and can’t wait to spend another year here. The staff is increasingly friendly, kind, and welcoming. The events are top notch and trust I make all my friends jealous and try to convince them to live here too. Thank you Trellis for making this home the best one yet!

title: Trellis House Apartments
name: Noah Stevens
text: I was an early resident of this new building, and it has been great, even as they have reached capcity. Great staff, especially Antoinette at the front desk. Amenities are world class too.

title: Trellis House Apartments
name: Nicole
text: I have loved living in Trellis house. I spent a lot of time looking for a home in DC and found that Trellis provided the perfect blend of thoughtful staff, top notch amenities and friendly residents. I love the head concierge Antoinette, my experience here would not be the same without her. Overall, Trellis house is definitely one was the best new buildings in DC.

title: Trellis House Apartments
name: Madison Guy
text: I go to Howard University across the street and live in Trellis. I love it! The atmosphere and amenities are amazing and it is just an experience to live here. I love the concierge Antoinette! She’s awesome and makes living here so much better!

title: Trellis House Apartments
name: Sofia Levy
text: This apartment is fantastic. There are so many amenities including a pool, club room, great gym with a variety of top-notch equipment, and various events. They also have a wonderful staff that has taken wonderful care of me.

title: Trellis House Apartments
name: Ilana Multak
text: I love living in this beautiful apartment building! The amenities suit all of my needs and the people who work here are amazing. Special shout out to Antoinette.

title: Trellis House Apartments
name: Terry Morris
text: As a current resident, I will say this has been one of the best decisions I made.  I was one of the first residents to move-in over a year ago...I have never regretted the decision.  If you are looking for a “place away from home”, this is it!  Highly recommended!!!!

title: Trellis House Apartments
name: Fanise Cannon
text: Concierge (both morning and night) are attentive, respectful and make living at Trellis House amazing!

title: Trellis House Apartments
name: Nader Aryan
text: I have been living for the past 8 months or so and found the building not as what I expected. Poorly built!  Management needs improvement/change.

title: Trellis House Apartments
name: John
text: Flooring is built extremely poor — you can hear your neighbors. If you get into the building look at how unbalanced and poor the building was built— specially look at the area by elevators. The biggest downside is that it’s near the Howard University and it’s very loud, specially on the weekends. Third, staff, not all of them are not professional and nice. Fourth, you can find much cheaper place in other parts of DC. Now you make the decision. I do not recommend you live here! They make it sound it’s the best thing you’ve ever seen but trust me!

title: Trellis House Apartments
name: Vanessa D
text: It has been oh so wonderful. This home has everything, from wonderful concierge to leasing staff to gym to pool and grill and to my apartment. Do I wish I left my apartment more to meet new humans? Yes sometimes, but it’s just too cozy here to want to leave. I couldn’t imagine anywhere else to call home. And boy do I get a kick out of showing this spot to my friends who do come over. I feel like I’m living a 9.89 out of 10 luxurious lifestyle. (Pst don’t tell anyone, but I really really am)

title: Trellis House Apartments
name: Jerrod Lewis
text: I had the opportunity to tour Trellis House today. Addison who has only been with the company for 5 months made me feel welcomed in every way possible. From his greeting,walking me through the amenities, and the floor plans he was absolutely great. What stood out the most was his fun personality and if he didn’t know an answer to a specific question he would go out of his way to find out for me. Trellis is absolutely beautiful with unique amenities and spacious floor plans. I felt valued as a potential future resident and for that alone I am thankful for good people like Addison.

title: Trellis House Apartments
name: Navya Kanderi
text: Antoinette is the best! Super sweet and helpful. Trellis has great amenities and is a great atmosphere.

title: Trellis House Apartments
name: Bonnie D Murphy
text: The Trellis House staff is first class. From the send off 6:30am to the welcome home at 6:00pm, the team gives the tenants an over the top experience. They truly care... Thank you Trellis House!

title: Trellis House Apartments
name: Duan Samuels
text: I've lived here since March of this year and I really love this place let me get that off my chest. I'm here from Arkansas and I'm used to having front and back yards and staying in a house. This is my first experience with an apartment and to be honest I wasn't happy about it, but for convenience it was the best option. From day one going on the tour and going over the applying process I felt welcomed by every member of the staff. But what really sold me was the calendar of events residents can attend and meet our neighbors. These events are special to me because I have no idea about city living and the multitude of things to do here. A special praise to the brain child of the events Mrs. Antoinette at the front desk, those events has changed my mind about apartments! Thanks to all of you for a outstanding experience. I'm not even a year into the lease and will definitely renew/recommend. Thank you for reading and please post on public also I was having trouble doing it myself.
